title: Date change request choices
decision: The seven days of BR-15 run from the moment of the decline; an accepted request's promise is recorded as made at the customer's request with the customer's reason; a direct change by the shop to the requested date or later closes an open request as accepted, and one tap in chat decides; fully paid is judged by the oldest-first allocation; a request is refused in a suspended shop; a column decline_reason was added to the approved table; nobody is told when a request expires
context: Decided by an agent during the autonomous build under DEC-020; implemented and awaiting the founder's review
chosen_option: Choices as listed in pull request 38
rationale: BR-15 names the wait and the single open request but not from when the wait is counted or what a direct change does to an open request
